$comment: HumanGateway protocol v1.0.0 (2026-08-28). Shared definitions referenced by the core entity schemas; never duplicated in consumer schemas (NF-06).
title: HumanGateway Protocol — Shared Definitions
description: Reusable building blocks (durable IDs, RFC 3339 timestamps, content hashes, typed participant addresses, errors, correlation tokens) referenced via $ref by the core protocol entity schemas.

id.title: Durable ID
id.description: A durable, globally unique identifier assigned by the creating gateway and stable for the lifetime of the entity (SYNC-FR-01). UUIDv4 or ULID recommended. Never reused after deletion.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with a trailing 'Z'. All protocol timestamps are UTC so that ordering across gateways is unambiguous.

contentHash.title: Content Hash
contentHash.description: SHA-256 digest of the content bytes (the canonical message envelope, or an artifact file), lowercase hex, prefixed 'sha256:'. Computed and verified by both sync peers (SYNC-FR-02, SP-06).

participantAddress.title: Participant Address
participantAddress.description: Typed participant address. The prefix identifies the participant kind — human:, agent:, system: (PROTO-FR-02). The suffix is a stable local alias (e.g. an email-like or gateway-local identifier).

error.description: The protocol error model (protocol §7 #3). Single source of truth: error.schema.json. Used by delivery FAILED records and sync/API error responses. Never carries secrets (SP-07).

correlationTokens.title: Correlation Tokens
correlationTokens.description: Opaque consumer (e.g. FlowForge) correlation tokens passed through the protocol unchanged so consumers can enforce role-checks and audit without HumanGateway duplicating them (SP-09, AUTH-FR-06).
